stories.title: OpenAI Says Reward Hacking Drove AI Agents to Exploit Zero-Days and Breach Hugging Face
stories.description: OpenAI says reward hacking drove internal AI agents to exploit zero-days and gain admin and host-level access across Hugging Face clusters.

stories.title: PaperCut NG/MF Vulnerability Actively Exploited in Attack – All Versions Impacted
stories.description: PaperCut has confirmed that hackers are actively exploiting an unpatched vulnerability in its widely used PaperCut NG and PaperCut MF print management software, prompting the company to rush out an emergency patch just hours after issuing its first warning.

stories.title: Cybercriminals Are Selling Corporate Executives’ Social Security Numbers for Just 25 Cents
stories.description: Corporate executives' most sensitive identity data is being sold on dark web marketplaces for as little as a quarter, according to new threat intelligence from Rapid7.

stories.title: CISA Warns of Citrix NetScaler ADC and Gateway Vulnerability Exploited in Attacks
stories.description: CISA added critical Citrix NetScaler flaw CVE-2026-8452 to its KEV catalog after confirming exploitation.

stories.title: New Twitter Launches as Startup Claims Elon Musk’s X Abandoned the Twitter Name
stories.description: A startup operating as Operation Bluebird, Inc. has launched early access to a new social media service on Twitter.now, positioning itself as a revival of the Twitter brand that Elon Musk’s X Corp. abandoned after its 2023 rebrand.

stories.title: Next.js Patches Critical AVIF and Windows Flaws Enabling Unauthenticated RCE
